The research agent commits straight to master for this file (no PR — this queue has zero effect on the live app, nothing reads it except the review agent and the admin dashboard's Growth Insights context). A second, independent daily agent (.claude/agents/curia-suggestion-review.md) re-verifies each `pending` entry and is the thing that promotes one into the real docs/data/venues.json, pushing straight to master after its own independent re-verification (see that file's own 2026-09-04 doc comment for why the human checkpoint moved to Curia Command's Pending Review tab instead of a PR here). Each entry mirrors docs/data/venues.json's own raw shape (name/district/type/spend/lat/lon/base/bands/reason) exactly, so a reviewed-and-approved entry can be moved into that file with a straight copy-paste, plus review-only fields (suggestedDate, status, researchNotes) that get stripped on promotion. `district` values must be a real existing district id from docs/data/districts.json (manchester/cheshire metros only) UNLESS the entry is itself proposing a brand-new district — see district-suggestions.json for that case instead; a venue suggestion should never invent a district id that doesn't exist anywhere.
_reviewWorkflow: status starts 'pending' on every new entry. The daily curia-suggestion-review agent changes it to 'approved'/promoted (then copies the venue fields into docs/data/venues.json and removes the entry here, pushed straight to master) or 'rejected' (left here with researchNotes explaining why, as a record so the same candidate isn't re-suggested later — curia-research-daily checks every entry here regardless of status before suggesting anything new). Genuinely uncertain candidates go to docs/data/pending-review-queue.json instead, staying 'pending' here until a human decides via Curia Command. A human's actual review happens by reading Curia Command's daily briefing and Pending Review tab, not by editing this file directly, though a human reviewer (or a future admin-dashboard screen) can still hand-edit an entry's status here if needed.
